$comment: Starting values for this install. On first run everything here is copied into config.local.json next to it, which becomes the working file - every change you make on the setup pages, and every login token, is written there. This file is only the seed: editing it afterwards adds any setting missing from the working file, but never overwrites what you have changed. 'presets' names the folder each feature keeps its presets in. 'files' names each feature's own data file: commands, auto-messages and the timer each get a <name>.initial.config that ships with the toolkit and is never written to, plus a <name>.local.config copied from it the first time - so you can edit the starter commands freely without losing the examples. Delete a .local.config to get the examples back. To start over completely, delete config.local.json. refreshSeconds (YouTube only): how often to check for new chat; '10' means every 10 seconds, honoured exactly unless YouTube's own minimum is higher or the daily allowance is running low. Twitch and Kick push messages instantly and need no setting.
